items.title: Microsoft releases MAI-Transcribe-2-Streaming, MAI-Voice-2.1 and MAI-Voice-2.1-Flash
items.summary_en: Microsoft announced three speech models. MAI-Transcribe-2-Streaming does real-time transcription in 60 languages with automatic language detection. MAI-Voice-2.1 and its cheaper, lower-latency Flash variant do text-to-speech in 23 languages and can clone a voice from a few seconds of audio. Per search snippets, they are available via Microsoft Foundry and partner platforms.
items.source_name: Microsoft Tech Community - Azure AI Foundry Blog
